mapper.update: UPDATE INGREDIENT SET INGREDIENT_NAME = #{ingredientName}, INGREDIENT_TYPE = #{ingredientType}, DEFAULT_UNIT = #{defaultUnit}, ACTIVE_YN = NVL(#{activeYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y'), UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE INGREDIENT_ID = #{ingredientId}
mapper.select:
SELECT INGREDIENT_ID AS ingredientId, INGREDIENT_NAME AS ingredientName, INGREDIENT_TYPE AS ingredientType, DEFAULT_UNIT AS defaultUnit, ACTIVE_YN AS activeYn, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createdAt FROM INGREDIENT
ORDER BY INGREDIENT_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY
